source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Σέλευκος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page gives one sentence and a distich and nothing else. **He is neither of the two Seleucuses the corpus keeps**: `seleucus-of-cappadocia` and `seleucus-of-tomis`, the martyr with Gordian, are on other days and die other deaths; this one is sawn asunder. The page gives him no year, no place and no companions. No hymn, no relics.
